assertion.statement: When retention is enabled, -compactor.delete-request-store (or its YAML setting delete_request_store) must now be explicitly configured to store delete requests.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: Exposure needs retention enabled and delete request store unset, but the config key paths (e.g. retention_enabled) are not named in the evidence.; consequence: Evidence says it is required for storing delete requests but does not state what fails if it is not configured.
